title: smaller than it appears
text:
smaller than it appears. Chair is very well made! It is beautiful and the leather is very nice. I love the look of it and it appears well made.
The only con is it was rated for 400 lbs and it is too small for a large person. My husband and I only weigh 220 to 260 but it is too small for us to sit back and be comfortable and it is not wide enough for us so I cannot imaging someone 300 to 400 lbs being able to use it. Would be great for kids and smaller people.
